name: Love or Lust Beach Stories
source:
Welcome to Love and Last Beach Stories — a sun-drenched, adult story adventure set on a tropical beach.

You're a college student looking for a summer gig — and maybe a little flirt. When you land a job at a trendy beach bar, things heat up fast. Beautiful strangers, secret rituals, ancient myths, and choices that matter.
But when the sunsets get stranger and the cocktails start whispering secrets...
You realize this summer might change more than your life.
It might change the world.
translation:
欢迎来到《爱情与最后的海滩故事》——这是一个以热带海滩为背景的阳光普照的成人冒险故事。

你是一名大学生，正在寻找一份暑期工作——也许还需要一点调情。当你在时尚的海滩酒吧找到工作时，事情会迅速升温。美丽的陌生人、秘密仪式、古老神话和重要的选择。
但当日落变得陌生，鸡尾酒开始低声诉说秘密时……
你意识到这个夏天可能改变的不仅仅是你的生活。
它可能会改变世界。
